setup_page_body: Choose city to display the air quality data for, either by manually searching by giving the country, state, and city parameters or by using GPS
aqi_body:
Appears after a successful Setup
Displays the relevant air quality information 
Shows a burger menu button in the top right corner which launches the navigation drawer
nav_body:
Settings menu item launches the Setup Page or a similar page with options for choosing the place for air quality data.
Language menu item makes it possible to switch languages on the fly.
About menu item displays a simple dialog with app name, version information and option to check opensource licenses.
